title: Subtractive: CNC routing

learningObjectives: Set up a CAM job for a 2.5D part
Choose bits and feeds for a material
Explain fixturing and safety for CNC

content:
2.5D vs. 3D milling; toolpaths; bits; feeds and speeds; fixturing, tabs, and zeroing; materials; CAM workflow; the CNC job with the lab tech.

Ideas

Subtractive constraints (tool radius, reach, undercuts); the toolpath as drawing at scale; stock, waste, and nesting; relief and topography.

In class

  • Lecture (35)
  • CAM demo (40)
  • CNC run with the tech (60)
  • relief exercise starts
